missing_methods.intent: Assert user profile name is visible in dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the user profile name element in the dashboard header to be visible. Verify that the displayed profile name matches the expected_name parameter. Return True if visible and matches, otherwise raise an assertion error with a descriptive message.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'user_profile_name' to be visible using .wait_for(state='visible')
Use expect() to verify 'user_profile_name' is visible with expect(user_profile_name_element).to_be_visible()
Get text content from 'user_profile_name' element using .text_content() or .inner_text()
Assert retrieved text matches expected_name parameter
If assertion fails, raise AssertionError with descriptive message including expected vs actual values
